name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.ClassLock.tseitin_example_lock
title: An unsatisfiable 4-variable NAND Tseitin CNF whose clause slots, under class-covered moves and level-0 cover flips, never yield an all-ones slot
statement: Levels 0..3 carry w, n1 = NAND(w, w), n2 = NAND(w, n1), out = NAND(n2, n2); the eight Tseitin clauses with the unit clause (out) are unsatisfiable. Start from slots that are zero programs or these eight clause cubes. If every step changes one slot either so that every string alive in the new slot is alive, before the step, in a slot with the same level-0 entries, or by a level-0 cover flip (a cover with entry 1 at (0, b) and only 1-entries after level 0), then no slot is ever all-ones.
